title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
title_zh: ActionRAG：面向 LLM 智能体长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散

paragraphs.en: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG , a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 5.4 points. Under MAB’s query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below $0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p 99 p_{99} components is 440.7 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体需要长期记忆，能够从不断增长的交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致的证据，尤其是当答案依赖于事实之间的关系而非孤立的语义匹配时。 当前的记忆流水线在两个阶段仍然脆弱：索引错误可能碎片化重复实体或合并不同实体，而在线检索往往将初始相似度分数视为最终结果，即使周围的图谱提供了修正它们的证据。 我们提出ActionRAG，一种将谨慎索引与查询时图回溯评估相耦合的图记忆架构。 其索引流水线协调类型标签并应用分层实体消解。 给定查询，双通道的实体和三元组检索构成初始证据集，并诱导出一个有界的局部图。 查询条件下的接收者归一化扩散利用局部路径结构来精炼三元组分数。 种子保护、枢纽惩罚通量和三元组物化在恢复遗漏连接的同时保留了直接证据。 我们在MemoryAgentBench（MAB）上评估ActionRAG，该基准测试准确检索、冲突消解、长程理解和测试时学习。 在其八个确定性评分列上，ActionRAG取得55.1 55.1的平均准确率，比最强的基于检索的记忆基线提升5.4 5.4个点。 在MAB的查询时成本核算下，在四个报告的成本列上，平均合成成本保持在每查询0.001美元以下，且在我们消费级Apple Silicon设备上，分别测得的检索侧p 99 p_{99}各分量之和为440.7 440.7毫秒。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents accumulate information across many turns of interaction and must recall, reconcile, and update facts as those interactions unfold. A useful memory for such agents is not a single skill but a bundle of them: looking up a specific fact buried deep in past dialogue, reasoning across several facts to answer a multi-hop question, recognizing when a new statement supersedes an older one, and absorbing fresh information at test time. MemoryAgentBench (MAB) ( Hu et al., 2026 ) operationalizes exactly this view, evaluating memory in LLM agents via incremental multi-turn interactions along four competencies: accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and conflict resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在多轮交互中不断积累信息，并必须随着这些交互的展开对事实进行回忆、协调和更新。 对这类智能体有用的记忆并非单一技能，而是一组技能的集合：查找埋藏在过往对话深处的某个具体事实、跨多个事实进行推理以回答多跳问题、识别新陈述何时取代旧陈述，以及在测试时吸收新信息。 MemoryAgentBench（MAB）（Hu et al., 2026）恰恰将这一观点操作化，通过增量式多轮交互，沿四项能力评估 LLM 智能体的记忆：准确检索、测试时学习、长程理解和冲突解决。

paragraphs.en: The dominant memory architecture today is dense retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) : chunk the interaction history, embed each chunk, and look up the top- k k matches per query. This flat index works for single-hop fact recall but loses signal on multi-hop reasoning (each chunk is scored in isolation) and on conflict resolution (a superseded fact and the fact that overrides it share most of their semantic content and become indistinguishable to a chunk embedder). The result is a measurable accuracy gap on exactly the MemoryAgentBench slices that real agents need to handle.
paragraphs.zh: 当今占主导地位的记忆架构是稠密检索增强生成（RAG）（Lewis et al., 2020）：将交互历史分块，对每个块进行嵌入，并为每个查询查找前 k 个匹配项。 这种扁平索引适用于单跳事实回忆，但在多跳推理上会丢失信号（每个块都是被孤立评分的），在冲突解决上也是如此（一条被取代的事实与取代它的事实共享大部分语义内容，对块嵌入器而言变得无法区分）。 其结果是在真实智能体需要应对的 MemoryAgentBench 各个切片上出现了可测量的准确率差距。

paragraphs.en: Graph-structured memory addresses this by representing the agent’s history as a typed entity–relation graph. Microsoft’s GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) and LightRAG ( Guo et al., 2024 ) use shallow heuristic traversal over the resulting graph, which is fast but loses much of the multi-hop signal. HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) and its successor HippoRAG-v2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) take the stronger route of extracting named entities from the query, linking them to nodes in a global corpus graph, and using those nodes to seed Personalized PageRank (PPR) ( Page et al., 1999 ; Haveliwala, 2002 ) . This provides effective associative retrieval, but it introduces an LLM call before every graph search and makes retrieval depend on the entities retained by that call. Predicate-level cues that are not expressed as salient named entities may therefore receive weak or no initial activation, causing relevant relations to be overlooked. ActionRAG instead retrieves both entity and concrete triple seeds directly, then uses local graph diffusion to retroevaluate the resulting triples. This removes query-time LLM parsing from retrieval while preserving relational cues that entity-only seeding can miss.
paragraphs.zh: 图结构记忆通过将智能体的历史表示为一个带类型的实体–关系图来解决这个问题。 微软的 GraphRAG（Edge 等，2024）和 LightRAG（Guo 等，2024）对生成的图采用浅层启发式遍历，速度快但会丢失大量多跳信号。 HippoRAG（Gutiérrez 等，2024）及其后续工作 HippoRAG-v2（Gutiérrez 等，2025）采取了更强的路线：从查询中抽取命名实体，将其链接到全局语料图中的节点，并用这些节点作为个性化 PageRank（PPR）（Page 等，1999；Haveliwala，2002）的种子。 这提供了有效的联想式检索，但它在每次图搜索之前都引入一次 LLM 调用，并使检索依赖于该调用所保留的实体。 因此，那些未表现为显著命名实体的谓词级线索可能只获得较弱甚至没有初始激活，导致相关关系被忽略。 ActionRAG 则直接检索实体和具体三元组两种种子，然后利用局部图扩散对所得三元组进行回溯评估。 这在检索时省去了对查询的 LLM 解析，同时保留了仅以实体作种子时可能遗漏的关系性线索。

paragraphs.en: Although an agent’s memory may be large, evidence relevant to a particular query often occupies a small region once plausible entities and relations have been identified. ActionRAG builds this region over a cautiously indexed entity–relation graph. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels, resolves repeated or ambiguous entities through tiered checks, and preserves source provenance. At query time, direct retrieval over both entities and concrete triples produces an initial evidence set. ActionRAG then constructs a bounded local graph and applies query-conditioned, receiver-normalized diffusion to revise triple relevance using surrounding path structure. Graph connectivity therefore acts as a second-stage evaluator of retrieved evidence rather than replacing semantic retrieval altogether. We evaluate ActionRAG on the eight deterministic-scoring columns of MemoryAgentBench. ActionRAG has the highest reported score among retrieval-based memory agents on six of the eight columns where the unweighted mean of these heterogeneous scores is 55.1 55.1 , 5.4 5.4 points above HippoRAG-v2.

paragraphs.en: One line of work expands the context window to hold an entire interaction history. Frontier models offer 128K–1M token contexts ( OpenAI, 2024b ; Anthropic, 2024 ; Gemini Team, Google, 2024 ) , while position interpolation ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , NTK and YaRN scaling ( Peng et al., 2024 ) , and LongRoPE ( Ding et al., 2024 ) extend them further. However, accuracy declines when relevant information lies deep in the window ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Kamradt, 2023 ) , and inference cost rises with context length, so long context alone is insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 一条工作路线将上下文窗口扩展到能够容纳完整的交互历史。 前沿模型提供 128K–1M 词元的上下文（OpenAI, 2024b；Anthropic, 2024；Gemini Team, Google, 2024），而位置插值（Chen et al., 2023）、NTK 与 YaRN 缩放（Peng et al., 2024）以及 LongRoPE（Ding et al., 2024）可将其进一步扩展。 然而，当相关信息深藏于窗口之中时，准确率会下降（Liu et al., 2024；Kamradt, 2023），且推理成本随上下文长度上升，因此仅有长上下文是不够的。

paragraphs.en: External-memory systems instead store information around the LLM. MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2024 ) pages between a small in-context working memory and a larger archive, a design productionised by Letta ( Letta, 2024 ) . Mem0 and Mem0g ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) extract structured user facts and retrieve them through a learned policy. A-MEM ( Xu et al., 2025 ) adds agentic links and a self-organising memory graph and Zep ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) maintains a temporal knowledge graph for evolving facts. paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Guu et al., 2020 ) conditions an LLM on top- k k documents retrieved by a sparse model such as BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) or a dense bi-encoder ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Izacard et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . Recent embedding baselines include proprietary OpenAI Text-Embedding-3 models ( OpenAI, 2024a ) and Qwen3-Embedding ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Stronger pipelines add cross-encoder or LLM re-rankers ( Nogueira et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2023 ) , or late-interaction models such as ColBERT and ColBERTv2 ( Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ; Santhanam et al., 2022 ) . On MemoryAgentBench, dense RAG is competitive for accurate retrieval but underperforms on multi-hop and conflict-resolution questions. Independent chunk scoring misses cross-chunk structure and cannot reliably distinguish semantically similar statements when one supersedes the other.

paragraphs.en: A complementary line structures retrieval through graphs or persistent memory. RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) builds a tree of recursive summaries, GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) extracts an entity–relation graph and summarises its communities for global queries, and LightRAG ( Guo et al., 2024 ) combines local entity and global relation retrieval over a lightweight graph. Cognee ( Markovic et al., 2025 ) optimises the interface between knowledge graphs and LLMs for multi-hop reasoning. These approaches can underrepresent specific relational paths through summarization or heuristic expansion. Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) extracts and consolidates salient conversational memories, and its graph variant represents entities and relations to support relational retrieval. A-MEM ( Xu et al., 2025 ) organises memories as Zettelkasten-inspired notes with generated attributes and dynamic links, updating existing notes as new evidence arrives. MemoRAG ( Qian et al., 2025 ) instead uses a dual-system architecture: a lightweight long-range model forms global memory and generates draft-answer clues that guide retrieval for a more expressive answering model.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的技术路线通过图结构或持久记忆来组织检索。 RAPTOR（Sarthi 等，2024）构建递归摘要树，GraphRAG（Edge 等，2024）抽取实体–关系图并对其社区进行摘要以支持全局查询，LightRAG（Guo 等，2024）则在轻量级图上结合局部实体检索与全局关系检索。 Cognee（Markovic 等，2025）优化知识图谱与大语言模型之间的接口，以支持多跳推理。 这些方法可能因摘要或启发式扩展而低估某些特定的关系路径。 Mem0（Chhikara 等，2025）抽取并整合显著的对话记忆，其图变体通过表示实体和关系来支持关系型检索。 A-MEM（Xu 等，2025）将记忆组织为受卡片盒笔记法启发的笔记，带有生成的属性和动态链接，并随着新证据的到来更新已有笔记。 MemoRAG（Qian 等，2025）则采用双系统架构：一个轻量的长程模型构建全局记忆并生成草稿答案线索，用以引导检索，从而服务于表达能力更强的回答模型。

paragraphs.en: HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) seeds Personalized PageRank ( Page et al., 1999 ; Haveliwala, 2002 ) over a corpus-level entity graph using query-relevant entities, then aggregates propagated scores to passages. HippoRAG-v2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) strengthens passage integration and the online use of an LLM. More broadly, graph diffusion propagates local relevance through weighted transition powers, with Personalized PageRank and heat kernels as common instances ( Klicpera et al., 2019 ) . Collectively, these methods span community summarization, dynamic memory linking, memory-guided clue generation, and global graph propagation, with trade-offs in query-time model calls, graph-wide computation, and dependence on preselected entity cues.
paragraphs.zh: HippoRAG（Gutiérrez et al., 2024）使用与查询相关的实体，在语料库级别的实体图上启动个性化 PageRank（Page et al., 1999；Haveliwala, 2002），然后聚合传播到段落的分数。 HippoRAG-v2（Gutiérrez et al., 2025）强化了段落整合以及 LLM 的在线使用。 更广泛地说，图扩散通过加权转移幂传播局部相关性，个性化 PageRank 和热核是其中常见的实例（Klicpera et al., 2019）。 总体而言，这些方法涵盖了社区摘要、动态记忆链接、记忆引导的线索生成和全局图传播，并在查询时模型调用次数、全图计算以及依赖预选实体线索方面各有权衡。

paragraphs.en: ActionRAG separates persistent memory construction from query-local retrieval. It assumes that each query touches only a bounded neighborhood of the accumulated interaction graph, so evidence diffusion operates on a query-conditioned subgraph rather than the corpus-level graph. paragraphs.en: For each chunk, an LLM emits typed entity mentions and directed ( head , relation , tail ) (\text{head},\text{relation},\text{tail}) mentions with textual descriptions. The current type vocabulary is supplied as a soft constraint, allowing the extractor to introduce a more specific label when no existing type is suitable. Dates, durations, and temporal phrases are retained inside the corresponding entity or relation description rather than represented as graph nodes. When a dialogue has a session timestamp, relative phrases such as “yesterday” or “last week” are converted to absolute dates using that timestamp. The resolved date is stored in the fact description instead of creating a separate node for it.

paragraphs.en: Mentions are resolved after their types have been canonicalized. A unique node with the same normalized name and a compatible type is reused directly. If no exact match exists, the indexer reuses a fuzzy name match only when it is the clear best candidate. All remaining mentions are grouped by normalized name, canonical type, and description similarity. One node is then created for each group before any relations are written, preventing parallel workers from creating duplicate nodes. Resolved entity pairs are stored as typed triples, with repeated observations merged into the same edge. Each graph item retains links to its source chunks, preserving the original evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 在提及项的类型完成规范化之后再进行消解。 若存在具有相同规范化名称且类型兼容的唯一节点，则直接复用该节点。 如果不存在精确匹配，索引器仅当模糊名称匹配是明显的最佳候选时才会复用它。 其余所有提及项按规范化名称、规范类型以及描述相似度进行分组。 在写入任何关系之前，先为每个组各创建一个节点，从而防止并行工作进程创建重复节点。 已消解的实体对以带类型的三元组形式存储，重复的观察结果合并到同一条边上。 每个图项都保留指向其来源块的链接，以保留原始证据。

paragraphs.en: Semantic retrieval scores graph items independently. It can therefore retrieve two strongly matching facts while missing the relation that connects them, simply because the connecting relation is not itself similar to the query. Unrestricted graph expansion has the opposite problem: high-degree entities introduce many generic facts and consume the context budget. ActionRAG treats the initial retrieval as a proposal rather than a final result. It constructs a bounded query-local graph, retroevaluates each proposed item using nearby evidence, removes weak proposals, and exposes useful relations that were absent from the initial set.
paragraphs.zh: 语义检索对图中的条目独立打分。 因此它可能检索出两条强匹配的事实，却遗漏连接它们的关系，原因仅仅是这条连接关系本身与查询不相似。 无限制的图扩展则存在相反的问题：高度数实体引入大量泛化性事实，消耗上下文预算。 ActionRAG 将初始检索视为候选提案，而非最终结果。 它构建一个有界的查询局部图，利用附近证据对每个候选条目进行回溯评估，剔除弱提案，并暴露初始集合中缺失的有用关系。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , which tests long-term memory through incremental multi-turn interactions. We report its eight deterministic task columns across four competencies: accurate retrieval (SH-DocQA, MH-DocQA, and EventQA), conflict resolution (FC-SH and FC-MH), long-range understanding (Detective QA), and test-time learning (MCC and Recom). All ActionRAG results use the receiver-normalized diffusion method in Section 3.3 ; unless stated otherwise, all baseline numbers are taken directly from the MAB paper. We compare against the MAB baseline families most relevant to retrieval-based memory: long-context references, simple and embedding RAG, structure-augmented RAG, and agentic memory agents, including HippoRAG-v2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MemoryAgentBench（Hu 等，2026）上评估 ActionRAG，该基准通过增量式多轮交互来测试长期记忆。 我们报告其四大能力下的八个确定性任务列：精确检索（SH-DocQA、MH-DocQA 和 EventQA）、冲突解决（FC-SH 和 FC-MH）、长程理解（Detective QA）以及测试时学习（MCC 和 Recom）。 所有 ActionRAG 的结果均使用第 3.3 节中的接收端归一化扩散方法；除非另有说明，所有基线数字均直接取自 MAB 论文。 我们将与 MAB 中与基于检索的记忆最相关的基线族进行比较：长上下文参考、简单 RAG 与嵌入 RAG、结构增强 RAG，以及智能体式记忆智能体，包括 HippoRAG-v2（Gutiérrez 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: ActionRAG combines reconciled graph construction with query-local receiver-normalized diffusion, pruning, and materialization for long-term agent memory. Across eight heterogeneous deterministic MAB columns, it records the highest reported retrieval-based score on six and an unweighted mean of 55.1 55.1 . Component ablations indicate that the best configuration combines reconciled, summarized indexing with retrieval-time refinement. Gains center on test-time learning and conflict resolution where weaker MH-DocQA and DetectiveQA results expose limits for narrative evidence. It also maintains low query cost and sub-half-second main-evaluation retrieval, while packed context remains nearly constant as the graph grows. Future work can include better algorithms for graph expansion which are more robust to hyperparameter values.
paragraphs.zh: ActionRAG 将调和式图构建与查询局部、接收者归一化的扩散、剪枝和物化相结合，用于智能体长期记忆。 在八个异构的确定性 MAB 列上，它在六列中取得了已报道的基于检索的最高分数，未加权平均分为 55.1 55.1 。 组件消融实验表明，最佳配置是将调和式、摘要式索引与检索时精炼相结合。 提升主要集中于测试时学习和冲突解决，而较弱的 MH-DocQA 和 DetectiveQA 结果暴露了其在叙事证据方面的局限。 它还保持了较低的查询成本和不到半秒的主评测检索时间，同时随着图的增长，打包上下文几乎保持不变。 未来的工作可以包括更好的图扩展算法，使其对超参数取值更加鲁棒。

paragraphs.en: We measure isolated retrieval, excluding answer generation, on the same Apple Silicon laptop with local Postgres/pgvector and no discrete GPU. Diffusion timing covers 50 MH-DocQA queries after initialization and includes local-graph construction, path scoring, solving, pruning, materialization, and packing, but excludes query embedding. BGE-M3 embedding is measured separately at batch size one with normalized embeddings, 20 warm-ups, and 200 measured calls. The reported p 99 p_{99} adds the two component p 99 p_{99} values and we omit concurrent full-retrieval wall time because database and Python scheduling make it more variable.
